Ogerpon

Grass

Paldea · Generation 9 · Legendary Pokémon

Ogerpon is a Grass-type Mask Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 39.8 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Attack (120), with a base stat total of 550.
